title: Adlai Nortye Announces $150.0 Million Private Placement Equity Financing
author: Na
description: Adlai Nortye Ltd. (Nasdaq: ANL), a clinical-stage biotechnology company, announced a $150 million private placement of 11.32 million ADSs at $13.25 per share. The oversubscribed offering attracted participation from new institutional investors including Soleus Capital, Perceptive Advisors, and ADAR1 Capital Management, as well as existing investors. The company plans to use proceeds to advance its RAS-targeting therapies and next-generation cancer immunotherapies pipeline.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company successfully raised $150 million in an oversubscribed private placement, demonstrating strong investor confidence. The participation of multiple high-quality institutional investors and the ability to price at the previous day's closing price indicate positive market sentiment toward the company's RAS-targeting pipeline and cancer therapy development programs.

title: Adlai Nortye Announces First Patient Enrolled in Global Phase 1 Trial of Pan-RAS (ON) Inhibitor AN9025 for Solid Tumors Harboring RAS Mutations
author: Na
description: Adlai Nortye Ltd. announced that the first patient has been dosed in the United States in its Phase 1 clinical trial of AN9025, an oral pan-RAS(ON) inhibitor for advanced solid tumors with RAS mutations. The trial is being conducted as a multi-regional clinical trial in collaboration with Jiangsu Aosaikang Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., with Adlai Nortye retaining ex-China rights and ASK Pharm holding rights in mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macao.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company achieved a significant clinical milestone by dosing the first patient in a Phase 1 trial of its lead candidate AN9025. This represents progress in clinical development and validates the company's therapeutic strategy for RAS-driven cancers, which is a major unmet medical need.

title: Adlai Nortye to Present Short Talk at AACR-NCI-EORTC International Conference on Molecular Targets and Cancer Therapeutics
author: Adlai Nortye Ltd.
description: Adlai Nortye will present research on AN4035, a novel CEACAM5-targeting antibody drug conjugate, at the AACR-NCI-EORTC International Conference on Molecular Targets and Cancer Therapeutics in Boston on October 25, 2025.

title: Adlai Nortye Ltd. to Present Encouraging Data of the Combination of AN0025 and Definitive Chemoradiotherapy (dCRT) at ASCO 2024
author: Adlai Nortye Ltd.
description: SINGAPORE and NORTH BRUNSWICK, N.J. and HANGZHOU, China, May  23, 2024  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Adlai Nortye Ltd. (NASDAQ: ANL) (the “Company” or “Adlai Nortye”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on the development of innovative cancer therapies, today announced that it will present encouraging preliminary data of AN0025 in combination with definitive chemoradiotherapy (dCRT) in unresectable locally advanced or locally recurrent esophageal cancer (EC) at the upcoming American Society of Cancer Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting to be held in Chicago from May 31 to June 4, 2024.
